correctness.rationale: The disease-free infected block gives the threshold n*Lambda*omega/[mu(omega+mu)(tau+mu)]. Simplifying the source's own displayed eigenvalue condition yields the same denominator, so the printed Eq. (4.10) is algebraically inconsistent with its preceding eigenvalues. The endemic coordinates are positive exactly above the corrected threshold. The endemic characteristic polynomial has positive coefficients and satisfies the strict cubic Routh-Hurwitz inequality. Symbolic replay and exact rational witnesses passed.

value.rationale: The reproduction threshold is used to distinguish extinction from persistence. The printed quantity is always larger than the correct one and can label a genuinely subcritical stable disease-free state as supercritical; the exact witness gives 2/3 versus 4/3. The correction also resolves the source's endemic interpretation by showing that the biologically feasible endemic branch exists above the corrected threshold and is locally stable throughout that branch for every allowed fractional order.
